Is AWWA C-900 Fusible PVC (FPVC) pipe an acceptable alternative to the casing crossings, like previous CalTrans projects?  The Dimension Ratio (DR) sizing can be matched to meet or exceed the Schedule sizing requirements.  The fused joint gasket-less system has a comparably smaller outer diameter since there is no bell, and can meet the initial requirements of 6" PVC inside 10" PVC casing, and 8" PVC inside 14" PVC casing without needing the upsized conduit per Addenda #4.

Supportive documentation and existing CalTrans project list can be provided. (Original Inquiry Date: 2021-06-23)
